ucs.title: [LLM] Akira pre-encryption: WMI-driven shadow copy wipe paired with backup/SQL service stop
ucs.description: Hunts Akira's signature inhibit-recovery chain: a single host running 'Get-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy | Remove-WmiObject' (or vssadmin/wmic shadowcopy delete) within ~30 min of stopping Veeam/MSSQL/backup services — the exact playbook documented in CISA AA24-109A and Sophos X-Ops Akira intrusions immediately before the .akira / .powerranges encrypter runs.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as shadowTime values(Processes.process) as shadowCmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as shadowParent values(Processes.user) as shadowUser from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe","vssadmin.exe","WMIC.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*Win32_Shadowcopy*" OR Processes.process="*Remove-WmiObject*" OR Processes.process="*Remove-CimInstance*Win32_Shadowcopy*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*Delete Shadows*" OR Processes.process="*vssadmin*delete*shadows*") by host Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner host [ | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as svcTime values(Processes.process) as svcCmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","powershell.exe","taskkill.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*stop *" OR Processes.process="*Stop-Service*" OR Processes.process="* /IM *sql*" OR Processes.process="*sc *delete*") AND (Processes.process="*Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*MSSQL*" OR Processes.process="*SQLWriter*" OR Processes.process="*Backup*" OR Processes.process="*VSS*" OR Processes.process="*MemTas*") by host ] | eval lagMin=round(abs(svcTime-shadowTime)/60,1) | where lagMin <= 30 | table shadowTime, host, shadowUser, shadowCmd, shadowParent, svcTime, svcCmd, lagMin | sort - shadowTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 30m;
let ShadowDel = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe","vssadmin.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Win32_Shadowcopy","Remove-WmiObject","Remove-CimInstance","shadowcopy delete","Delete Shadows")
         or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)vssadmin\s+delete\s+shadows\s*/all"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"                       // strip machine accounts
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("veeamagent.exe","veeam.backup.manager.exe")  // legit backup cleanup
    | project ShadowTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ShadowCmd=ProcessCommandLine, ShadowParent=InitiatingProcessFileName;
let SvcStop = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","powershell.exe","taskkill.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("stop ","Stop-Service","sc delete","/IM sql")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Veeam","MSSQL","SQLWriter","Backup","MemTas","VSS","vmms","SQLAgent")
    | project SvcTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, SvcCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
ShadowDel
| join kind=inner SvcStop on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', SvcTime, ShadowTime)) <= 30   // 30m = empirical Akira pre-encryption staging window
| summarize ShadowEvents=count(), SvcEvents=dcount(SvcCmd),
            FirstShadow=min(ShadowTime), LastSvcStop=max(SvcTime),
            ShadowCmds=make_set(ShadowCmd,5), SvcCmds=make_set(SvcCmd,8),
            Parents=make_set(ShadowParent,5)
            by DeviceName, AccountName
| order by FirstShadow desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ShadowDel = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe","\\wmic.exe","\\vssadmin.exe")
    | where CommandLine has_any ("Win32_Shadowcopy","Remove-WmiObject","Remove-CimInstance","shadowcopy delete","Delete Shadows")
         or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)vssadmin\s+delete\s+shadows\s*/all"
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project ShadowTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, ShadowUser=SubjectUserName,
              ShadowCmd=CommandLine, ShadowParent=ParentProcessName;
let SvcStop = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("\\net.exe","\\net1.exe","\\sc.exe","\\powershell.exe","\\taskkill.exe")
    | where CommandLine has_any ("stop ","Stop-Service","sc delete","/IM sql")
    | where CommandLine has_any ("Veeam","MSSQL","SQLWriter","Backup","MemTas","VSS","vmms","SQLAgent")
    | project SvcTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, SvcCmd=CommandLine;
ShadowDel
| join kind=inner SvcStop on Computer
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', SvcTime, ShadowTime)) <= 30
| summarize ShadowEvents=count(), SvcEvents=dcount(SvcCmd),
            FirstShadow=min(ShadowTime), LastSvcStop=max(SvcTime),
            ShadowCmds=make_set(ShadowCmd,5), SvcCmds=make_set(SvcCmd,8)
            by Computer, ShadowUser
| order by FirstShadow desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Akira Ransomware Pre-Encryption Shadow Copy Wipe via WMI/VSS
id: 6e8f1cda-1f1a-4d51-8b3a-akira01
status: experimental
description: Detects Akira's characteristic WMI-driven shadow copy deletion (Get-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy | Remove-WmiObject) and vssadmin variants, used immediately before the .akira / .powerranges encrypter is launched.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-109a
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2023/05/09/akira-ransomware-is-bringin-88-back
author: detection-eng
date: 2026/06/10
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.g1024
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
      - '\vssadmin.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Win32_Shadowcopy'
      - 'Remove-WmiObject'
      - 'Remove-CimInstance'
      - 'shadowcopy delete'
      - 'Delete Shadows'
      - 'vssadmin delete shadows'
  filter_backup_vendor:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\VeeamAgent.exe'
      - '\Veeam.Backup.Manager.exe'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and not filter_backup_vendor
falsepositives:
  - Authorised disaster-recovery testing
  - Backup product post-job cleanup outside of the vendor allow-list
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe) @CommandLine:(*Win32_Shadowcopy* OR *win32_shadowcopy* OR *Remove-WmiObject* OR *Remove-CimInstance* OR *"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"Delete Shadows"* OR *"delete shadows"*) -@ParentImage:(*\\VeeamAgent.exe OR *\\Veeam.Backup.Manager.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|wmic|vssadmin)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(Win32_Shadowcopy|Remove-WmiObject|Remove-CimInstance|shadowcopy\\s+delete|Delete\\s+Shadows|vssadmin\\s+delete\\s+shadows)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT ParentBaseFileName=/(veeamagent|veeam\.backup\.manager)\.exe/i
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(as=shadowEvents), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), collect([CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], multival=true)])
| shadowEvents >= 1

ucs.title: [LLM] Akira initial access: MFA-less SSL VPN logon followed by rapid RDP fan-out (Cisco ASA / SonicWall vector)
ucs.description: Hunts the Akira intrusion opener: a successful Cisco AnyConnect / SonicWall NetExtender / SSL VPN sign-in WITHOUT MFA, followed within 60 minutes by the same identity initiating RDP (LogonType 10) into ≥3 distinct internal hosts. This is the documented Akira playbook against CVE-2023-20269 (Cisco ASA) and CVE-2024-40766 (SonicWall SSLVPN).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as vpnTime values(Authentication.src) as vpnSrc values(Authentication.app) as vpnApp from datamodel=Authentication where (Authentication.app IN ("Cisco AnyConnect","Cisco Secure Client","Cisco SSL VPN","SonicWall SSL VPN","SonicWall NetExtender","Cisco ASA")) AND Authentication.action="success" by Authentication.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)` | rename user as vpnUser | join type=inner vpnUser [ | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as firstRdp max(_time) as lastRdp dc(Authentication.dest) as rdpHostCount values(Authentication.dest) as rdpHosts from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.signature_id="4624" AND Authentication.logon_type="10" by Authentication.user | rename Authentication.user as vpnUser ] | eval lagMin=round((firstRdp - vpnTime)/60,1) | where rdpHostCount >= 3 AND lagMin >= 0 AND lagMin <= 60 | lookup mfa_status_by_user user as vpnUser OUTPUT mfa_used | where mfa_used!="true" | table vpnTime, vpnUser, vpnApp, vpnSrc, firstRdp, lagMin, rdpHostCount, rdpHosts | sort - vpnTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 60m;
let RdpFanoutMin = 3;
let VpnAuth = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Application has_any ("Cisco AnyConnect","Cisco Secure Client","SonicWall","NetExtender","SSL VPN","AnyConnect")
         or ResourceDisplayName has_any ("Cisco AnyConnect","SonicWall","NetExtender")
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | where AuthenticationRequirement != "multiFactorAuthentication"   // Akira's hallmark — no MFA enforcement on VPN
    | project VpnTime=Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Country, Application;
let RdpFanout = DeviceLogonEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where LogonType == "RemoteInteractive"     // RDP / LogonType 10
    | where ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | extend AccountUpn = iff(isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn), InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, strcat(AccountName,"@",AccountDomain))
    | project RdpTime=Timestamp, AccountUpn, RdpTarget=DeviceName, RdpSrcIP=RemoteIP;
VpnAuth
| join kind=inner RdpFanout on AccountUpn
| where RdpTime between (VpnTime .. VpnTime + WindowMin)
| summarize FirstVpn=min(VpnTime), FirstRdp=min(RdpTime), LastRdp=max(RdpTime),
            DistinctRdpTargets=dcount(RdpTarget), RdpHosts=make_set(RdpTarget,15),
            VpnIPs=make_set(IPAddress,5), RdpSrcIPs=make_set(RdpSrcIP,5)
            by AccountUpn, Application, Country
| where DistinctRdpTargets >= RdpFanoutMin   // 3 = empirical fan-out floor in Akira IR cases
| extend LagFirstRdpMin = datetime_diff('minute', FirstRdp, FirstVpn)
| order by FirstVpn desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 60m;
let RdpFanoutMin = 3;
let VpnAuth = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AppDisplayName has_any ("Cisco AnyConnect","Cisco Secure Client","SonicWall","NetExtender","SSL VPN","AnyConnect")
         or ResourceDisplayName has_any ("Cisco AnyConnect","SonicWall","NetExtender")
    | where ResultType == 0
    | where AuthenticationRequirement != "multiFactorAuthentication"
    | project VpnTime=TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress,
              Country=tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), AppDisplayName;
let RdpFanout = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4624 and LogonType == 10
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | extend UserPrincipalName = iff(TargetUserName contains "@", TargetUserName, strcat(TargetUserName,"@",TargetDomainName))
    | project RdpTime=TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, RdpTarget=Computer, RdpSrcIP=IpAddress;
VpnAuth
| join kind=inner RdpFanout on UserPrincipalName
| where RdpTime between (VpnTime .. VpnTime + WindowMin)
| summarize FirstVpn=min(VpnTime), FirstRdp=min(RdpTime), LastRdp=max(RdpTime),
            DistinctRdpTargets=dcount(RdpTarget), RdpHosts=make_set(RdpTarget,15),
            VpnIPs=make_set(IPAddress,5), RdpSrcIPs=make_set(RdpSrcIP,5)
            by UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName, Country
| where DistinctRdpTargets >= RdpFanoutMin
| extend LagFirstRdpMin = datetime_diff('minute', FirstRdp, FirstVpn)
| order by FirstVpn desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:"Sign-in activity" @properties.appDisplayName:(*Cisco* OR *AnyConnect* OR *SonicWall* OR *NetExtender* OR "SSL VPN") @properties.status.errorCode:0 -@properties.authenticationRequirement:multiFactorAuthentication
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=UserLogon LogonType=10
| UserName!=/\$$/
| join({
    #event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog
    | regex("(?i)(cisco\\s+anyconnect|cisco\\s+secure\\s+client|sonicwall|netextender|ssl\\s*vpn)", field=ApplicationName)
    | Result=Success
    | MfaUsed!=true
    | rename(field=UserPrincipalName, as=UserName)
  }, field=UserName, include=[SourceIP, ApplicationName, _time])
| groupBy([UserName, ApplicationName], function=[count(field=ComputerName, distinct=true, as=rdpTargets), collect(ComputerName, multival=true, as=hosts), min(@timestamp, as=firstRdp)])
| rdpTargets >= 3
